answer_1.quote: Assay2Mol uses the LLM to generate molecules in batches of 10.

answer_2.quote: We use Vina Dock to score the binding complementarity of a molecule, or the strength of interaction, with a protein target. High Affinity indicates the percentage of generated molecules that outperform the reference molecules in Vina Dock. Quantitative Estimate of Drug-likeness (QED)… Synthetic Accessibility (SA) score… Diversity is quantified as the average pairwise Tanimoto distance… We also track the Molecule Size… We use ADMETlab 3.0 to predict the hERG score.
